data.fund_type: An open ended ultra-short term debt scheme investing in debt instruments such that the Macaulay duration of the portfolio isbetween 3 months and 6 months. A relatively low interest rate risk and Relatively high credit risk. * The Macaulay duration isthe weighted average term to maturity of the cash ﬂows from a bond. The weight of each cash ﬂow is determined by dividingthe present value of the cash ﬂow by the price.
